#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int diff;
    int index;
    Edge(int d, int i) : diff(d), index(i) {}
};

struct CompareEdge {
    bool operator()(const Edge& e1, const Edge& e2) const {
        if (e1.diff != e2.diff) return e1.diff > e2.diff;
        return e1.index > e2.index;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> odd(n);
    int balance = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
        balance += (a[i] & 1) == 0 ? 1 : -1;
        odd[i] = balance;
    }

    priority_queue<Edge, vector<Edge>, CompareEdge> pq;
    for (int i = 0; i + 1 < n; ++i) {
        pq.push(Edge(abs(a[i+1] - a[i]), i));
    }

    int ans = 0;
    while (!pq.empty() && pq.top().diff <= k) {
        Edge e = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        if (odd[e.index] == 0) {
            int nk = k - e.diff;
            if (nk >= 0) {
                ++ans;
                k = nk;
            }
        }
    }
    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
